The A-10, on the other hand, is designed for shorter-range missions, providing close support to ground forces. Its ability to operate from austere airfields close to the front lines further enhances its effectiveness in its designated role. Technological advancements also play a significant role in differentiating the A-10 from its WWII predecessors.
